summary: Gabor Hazas, 54, of Budapest, Hungary killed in an avalanche triggered about 1:25 p.m. Sunday in Maroon Bowl, a steep northwest-facing slope on Highland Peak just outside the Aspen Highlands ski area boundary; two others were caught in the same slide and escaped - one was brought down safely by rescue teams on skis and the other was airlifted by helicopter
location: Maroon Bowl, Highland Peak, outside Aspen Highlands ski area boundary
responding_agency: Pitkin County Sheriff Office; rescue teams
notes: Identified by the Pitkin County Coroner on Monday March 20 [merge 2026-09-15 run616: HotRR corroborates — Sunday avalanche just outside Aspen Highlands; three skiers caught, two escaped.] Run 817 merge: appended incident-specific source URL (parent-opened). Run 861 merge: MRA Facebook Page post (posted 2023-03-20, links PCSO press release '23P2975 - Maroon Bowl SAR') merged — post documents the MRA response (staged 2:15 PM Maroon Creek Rd, air resources requested; two uninjured skiers dug out the buried skier and did CPR until ~4:15 PM; Care Flight/Flight for Life unable to land; CO DFPC helicopter inserted two MRA rescuers 4:36 PM, confirmed deceased, 4:45 PM flight to Aspen/Pitkin County Airport; all out by 5:30 PM); post content read live in logged-in session by the MRA-FB browser task (tool-side browser_open of FB fails); matches id 2406 (2023-03-19 Maroon Bowl avalanche, Gabor Hazas fatality) exactly.
